name: Sundering
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 8th; Weight —; Price +1 Bonus

DESCRIPTION

A sundering weapon is especially effective at breaking inanimate objects. When used to attack an object or when making a sunder attempt, the wielder adds the weapon’s enhancement bonus as an additional bonus to attack rolls (this stacks with the attack bonus the enhancement bonus normally provides). The wielder of a sundering weapon does not provoke attacks of opportunity for making sunder attempts if he uses the weapon to do so.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells break; Cost +1 bonus
